notes: Porsche reports deliveries and employees by its five sales regions (FY2025, Annual and Sustainability Report 2025 published Mar 11, 2026); Germany is a region and a country, so it is stored as a country row (DE), once per metric. Only 'China incl. Hong Kong' carries a country list because the report names its members; 'North America excl. Mexico', 'Europe without Germany' and 'Overseas and Emerging Markets' are left null. Each region appears twice, once per metric, because deliveries and employees come from different passages. The employee table's column headers (Germany | Europe (without Germany) | North America excl. Mexico | China incl. Hong Kong | Overseas and emerging markets | Total) map to the values in order; the quote joins the table title and row with '…'. No per-country delivery figures (e.g. U.S.) appear in the report, and no U.S. state data. Documents are the English PDFs on newsroom.porsche.com, now under /assets/uploads/documents/ (Porsche notes only the German version is legally binding). Bratislava and Kulim are Volkswagen Group or third-party sites used by Porsche, not Porsche-owned plants. The Osnabrück site (Volkswagen Group contract manufacturing of the 718) was removed: the 2025 report says production there was discontinued at the end of October 2025.
